title: Shared provider runtime and Sourceright extraction — agent-panel evaluation

panel_protocol.limitation: The core provider runtime, compatibility adapters, and migration replacement maps are compiler- and fixture-verified. Live provider execution, downstream Sourceright dual runs, and external registry promotion remain open operational gates.

invariants_verified: Core provider kernel: ProviderRegistry, ExecutionPolicy, and PageExecutionContext enforce centralized execution bounds
Subrequest context safety: run_subrequest bounds cumulative child calls and respects cooperative cancellation
Shared rate groups: rate group registration prevents burst flooding across concurrent tasks
Comprehensive replacement mapping: migration/sourceright/replacement-map.yaml maps all legacy symbols
Parity execution matrix: v2 parity catalogue and matrix schemas validate 10 declared parity dimensions
Fail-closed companion change packet: migration/companion-repositories/sourceright.json disallows unreviewed remote mutations
Non-publishable default: release/public-packages.json enforces publish = false across all workspace crates

assertions_evaluated.notes: Compatibility adapter and feature flag structure verified.

assertions_evaluated.notes: Retries, cache, endpoint, rate and receipt behavior in shared core runtime verified.

assertions_evaluated.statement: Run old/new fixture parity and snapshot differences
assertions_evaluated.notes: Parity cases, v2 parity execution matrix, and snapshot diffing contracts verified.
SemVer and public API policy implications verified with non-publishable crate controls.

assertions_evaluated.notes: Reversible switch plan and companion change packet fail-closed configuration verified.

limitations: Core provider runtime and Sourceright migration contracts verified; live provider execution, downstream dual runs, and public release train promotion remain separate operational gates.
